*   **Thursday:** Priya is free 9:00-9:30, 10:00-10:30, 13:00-13:30, and 14:30-15:00. Marcus is free 10:00-10:30, 12:00-12:30, and 14:30-15:00. The common slots are 10:00-10:30 and 14:30-15:00.
*   **Friday:** Priya is free 11:00-12:00, 13:00-13:30, and 14:00-14:30. Marcus is free 11:00-12:00 and 14:30-15:00. The common availability is 11:00-12:00. This gives us two 30-minute slots: 11:00-11:30 and 11:30-12:00.

So, the list of possible slots is:
*   Mon 09:00-09:30
*   Mon 09:30-10:00
*   Tue 13:00-13:30
*   Tue 13:30-14:00
*   Wed 15:00-15:30
*   Wed 15:30-16:00
*   Thu 10:00-10:30
*   Thu 14:30-15:00
*   Fri 11:00-11:30
*   Fri 11:30-12:00

I will now write a message to Brad in the shared workspace, providing him with this list of slots and asking him to check them against the calendars of Elena Soto and David Okafor. I will then end my session to allow Brad to take his turn.
